label: KGhost
description: Race against a ghost on your Karoo: a fixed-pace Ghost Pace or your own past self on a route, stitched into one continuous ghost. Shows the live time/distance gap on graphical and numeric data fields and draws the ghost's position on the map. Records each ride automatically and can import GPX/FIT ghosts dropped in /sdcard/KGhost. Keeps estimating during GPS dropouts. Needs All files access: grant it in the KGhost app so it can find your past rides.
releaseNotes: KGhost now finds the rides already on your Karoo by itself - no Import button needed; without All files access it tells you on its data field and at ride start how to grant it. On a route you have barely ridden before, the ghost races your Ghost Pace target instead of sitting at 0, the gap shows --- until there is something to compare you with, and the SEG/GP tag tells you which one you are racing (SEG = your past self, GP = the Ghost Pace target).
